# winrt-Windows.System.Power.Diagnostics

Windows Runtime (WinRT) APIs for the `Windows.System.Power.Diagnostics` namespace.

This package provides the `winrt.windows.system.power.diagnostics` module.

The WinRT APIs in it are those of version 10.0.28000.2705 of the
`Microsoft.Windows.SDK.CPP` NuGet package.

```
pip install winrt-Windows.System.Power.Diagnostics
```

Other WinRT namespaces are packages of their own, so install the package of
each namespace your code imports from.
